text: dsh-transcript-export 是面向 DSH 网页端的会话导出插件，在助手回复操作栏提供导出入口，并在会话标题栏提供导出库入口。它读取会话内容，可将整段对话或最近若干轮整理为 Markdown、单文件 HTML 或 JSON；用户可以选择是否包含工具内容、思考过程和时间戳，并可保存副本以便之后筛选、打开或删除。插件还提供可选的 export_session 工具，供 agent 按请求导出会话。导出文件保存在本机配置目录，不需要 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-transcript-export adds export controls to the DSH web client. Save a conversation or recent rounds as Markdown, HTML, or JSON, with optional tool content and reasoning. Saved copies can be browsed in a local library. An optional agent tool exports conversations. No API key is required.
想把刚才的 DSH 对话整理成方便分享的 Markdown 文件。
能不能只导出当前回复之前最近几轮聊天，并选 HTML 或 JSON 格式？
I want to save a readable copy of my DSH chat and find it in a local export library later.
dsh-transcript-export 的功能「多格式会话导出」：从助手回复操作栏发起，可选整段或最近 N 轮，并输出 Markdown、HTML 或 JSON 文件。
dsh-transcript-export 的功能「本地导出库」：导出时可保存文件副本，并从会话标题栏打开导出库进行浏览和管理。

> 想把一段对话留下来，或者发给别人看看？

你和 Harness 折腾了半天，结论落在最后那条回复里，可支撑它的命令、报错、翻过的文件，全都散在几十个折叠块中间。想把它变成一份能发给同事、能存进笔记、过两个月自己还看得懂的文档——`Ctrl+A` 复制帮不上忙，它会把运行时脚手架、审批提示、工具 JSON 一起搬走；官方的 `dsh-session-log-export` 导出的是原始 zip 日志，想要能读的文档还得自己挖一遍。

这个插件就是干这件事的：在你正在读的那条回复下面点一下，挑个格式、划个范围，它把这段对话整理成一份干净、自包含、可以直接拿给人看的文档。

dsh-transcript-export README · dsh-transcript-export：

选格式 → 划回溯轮数 → 决定要不要工具输出、要不要脱敏 → 下载，或者先存进导出库。

dsh-transcript-export README · 它替你收拾的那些活：- 脚手架消息——运行时上下文、技能目录、时间采样、模型切换、审批提示——不进正文。它们是在渲染前就被滤掉的，不是导出后再用正则擦一遍。
- 工具调用收进一个可折叠的附录，参数和输出各自成块；太长的输出会截断，并老实写清楚截了多少字符。
- 正文按 Markdown 渲染出真正的结构：标题、表格、列表、引用、代码块、行内样式。但**先转义、后套结构**，对话里出现的任何标记都只会当文字显示。
- 思考过程默认不导出。想知道它当时在想什么，勾一下就有。
- 可以只导"你正在看的这条回复往前 N 轮"，不必每次把整段对话搬走。
- 顺手把密钥抹掉，默认开着，不用你惦记。

dsh-transcript-export README · 三种格式，看你拿它干嘛：| 格式 | 适合 |
| --- | --- |
| Markdown | 想粘进笔记、Wiki、仓库文档。diff 友好，改起来不别扭 |
| HTML | 想直接发给人看。单文件自包含：样式、目录、代码高亮、可折叠的工具块全在里面，双击就能开，离线也行，打印时过程自动收起来 |
| JSON | 想让脚本接着处理。带 `schemaVersion`、`generator` 和选项快照 |

范围可以选整段对话，也可以选"最近 N 轮"（滑杆 1…总轮数）。内容开关管工具调用、工具结果、思考过程、时间戳。脱敏认得 OpenAI、Anthropic、GitHub、GitLab、AWS、Slack、Google、Stripe 的 key，也认 JWT、Bearer/Basic、Cookie、`password=` / `api_key=` 这类赋值、带账号密码的 DSN 和 PEM 私钥。
section: 三种格式，看你拿它干嘛

dsh-transcript-export README · 它是怎么做到的：```
浏览器半片 (lib/client.js)                   Host 半片 (lib/index.js)
  conversation.chat.assistant-actions          webServer 前缀路由 /dsh-transcript-export
    └ 导出按钮 → 弹窗                              ├ prepare  会话概要 + 脱敏计数
  conversation.session.header.actions            ├ export   渲染并可选落盘

dsh-transcript-export README · 它是怎么做到的：- `lib/core.js` —— 文档模型、三个渲染器、脱敏、高亮。**零依赖、同步、没有副作用**，Host 进程中、浏览器里和 `node --test` 下跑的是同一份代码。
- `lib/index.js` —— 读 `sessionQuery.readSession(sessionId)` 的会话事件，整理成文档；在 `webServer` 上挂 `/dsh-transcript-export` 前缀路由（同源 + 回环校验、4 MB 请求上限、路径包含性校验防目录穿越）；可选注册 `export_session` 工具。
- `lib/client.js` —— 两个 Slot 入口，弹窗和导出库都是 React 写的（只用 `react` / `react/jsx-runtime` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 三个模块，没有 JSX，也没有构建步骤）。

dsh-transcript-export README · 安全这件事，我们是当真的：- 路由只认**同源 + 回环**的 `POST`：`Host` 头必须是 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]`，带 `Origin` 时必须和 `Host` 一致，其它来源一律 403。
- 导出库的 `read` / `delete` 只接受导出目录**里面**的路径，`../` 之类的直接拒绝。
- HTML 是**先转义、后套结构**：Markdown 只用来生成渲染器自己造的标签，对话里的 HTML 标记只会以文字出现——表格单元格、代码块、链接都一样，链接还只认 `http(s)://`。
- 脱敏默认开着，命中就换成 `[REDACTED]`；想关得你自己明确勾掉。
section: 安全这件事，我们是当真的

[中文](README.md) · **English**

> Want to keep a conversation somewhere — or hand it to someone else?

dsh-transcript-export README · dsh-transcript-export：You spend an hour working something out with Harness. The conclusion is in that last reply, but the commands that got you there, the errors, the files you read are scattered across dozens of collapsed blocks. Turning that into a document you can send to a colleague, drop into your notes, or still understand two months from now is not something `Ctrl+A` can do — it drags the runtime scaffolding, approval notices and raw tool JSON along for the ride. The official `dsh-session-log-export` hands you a zipped raw log and leaves the readable part to you.

dsh-transcript-export README · dsh-transcript-export：That gap is what this plugin fills. One click on the reply you are reading, pick a format and a range, and it turns the conversation into a clean, self-contained document you would not be embarrassed to hand to a person.

Pick a format → pick a range → decide about tool output and redaction → download, or keep a copy in the export library.

dsh-transcript-export README · The tidying-up it does for you：- Scaffolding messages — runtime context, skill catalog, time sampling, model switches, approval notices — never reach the body. They are filtered **before** rendering, not scrubbed afterwards with regexes.
- Tool calls fold into one appendix, arguments and output each in their own block. A long output is truncated and then says, in plain words, how much it cut.
- Prose is rendered as real Markdown structure — headings, tables, lists, quotes, code blocks, inline styles — but it is **escaped first, structured second**, so any markup inside a transcript shows up as text.
- Reasoning is off by default. One checkbox if you want to see what it was thinking.
- Export from the reply you are reading back 1…N rounds, instead of always moving the whole conversation.
- Secrets get redacted on the way out, on by default, so you do not have to remember.
section: The tidying-up it does for you

text:
dsh-transcript-export README · Three formats, depending on where it is going：| Format | Good for |
| --- | --- |
| Markdown | Pasting into notes, a wiki, or repository docs. Diffs cleanly and stays easy to edit |
| HTML | Sending to a person. One self-contained file: inline styles, a table of contents, code highlighting, collapsible tool blocks. Opens offline by double-click, and hides the process when printed |
| JSON | Feeding a script. Ships `schemaVersion`, `generator` and an options snapshot |

text: dsh-transcript-export README · Three formats, depending on where it is going：The range is either the whole conversation or "last N rounds" (a slider from 1 to the total). Content flags cover tool calls, tool results, reasoning and timestamps. Redaction knows OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, GitLab, AWS, Slack, Google and Stripe keys, plus JWTs, Bearer/Basic headers, cookies, `password=` / `api_key=` assignments, credentialed DSNs and PEM private keys.

text: dsh-transcript-export README · Three formats, depending on where it is going：Nothing leaves the machine: the Host half renders and writes locally, the browser half only talks to it over same-origin `POST /dsh-transcript-export/*`, and then hands the bytes to a Blob download. The export library lives under `$DSH_HOME/exports` (default `~/.dsh/exports`), newest first, filterable, openable and deletable in place.

Add the URL it is published at under **Settings → Plugins → Discover → Index sources** and the plugin becomes searchable and one-click installable, just like everyone else's.

dsh-transcript-export README · Getting into a plugin market：The list the bundled market shows comes from the curated [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin): open a PR there with one line and the site and `dsh-market` pick it up automatically, usually within a day. Shipping your own index is the second path — for people who would rather add a source than depend on a catalog.

dsh-transcript-export README · Using it：1. Hover any assistant reply and click the **download** button in its action row.
2. In the dialog, choose a format, drag the turn-range slider, and decide about tool output, reasoning, timestamps and redaction.
3. **Export** downloads the file. With "also keep a copy" ticked, it is written into `$DSH_HOME/exports` as well. Saving never overwrites: a second export of the same name becomes `-2`, `-3`, and so on.
4. The **Export library** button (folder icon in the session header) lists everything you kept, newest first — filter it, open it right there, or delete it.

dsh-transcript-export README · Or let the agent do it：```
export this conversation as markdown, last 3 rounds, no tool results
```

The agent calls `export_session`, the file lands in `$DSH_HOME/exports`, and it tells you the path.

dsh-transcript-export README · Configuration：Override in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. `config` replaces the whole block, so restate every key you want:

```yaml
- id: session-share
  config:
    exportDir: D:/notes/dsh-exports   # default: $DSH_HOME/exports

dsh-transcript-export README · How it works：```
browser half (lib/client.js)                 host half (lib/index.js)
  conversation.chat.assistant-actions          webServer prefix route /dsh-transcript-export
    └ Export button → dialog                      ├ prepare   summary + redaction count
  conversation.session.header.actions             ├ export    render, optionally save

dsh-transcript-export README · How it works：- `lib/core.js` — the document model, three renderers, redaction and highlighting. **No imports, synchronous, no side effects**, so the Host, the browser and `node --test` all run the same code.
- `lib/index.js` — reads events through `sessionQuery.readSession(sessionId)` and normalizes them, mounts the `/dsh-transcript-export` prefix route on `webServer` (same-origin + loopback fence, 4 MB body cap, containment checks against directory traversal), and optionally registers `export_session`.
- `lib/client.js` — two slot entries; the dialog and the library are React built by hand from `react`, `react/jsx-runtime` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` (no JSX, no build step).

dsh-transcript-export README · Security, taken seriously：- The route accepts only **same-origin, loopback** `POST`s: the `Host` header must be `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]`, and an `Origin` header must agree with it. Anything else is a 403.
- `read` / `delete` accept only paths **inside** the export folder; `../` and friends are refused.
- Every message, title and tool name is **escaped first, then structured**: Markdown only produces tags the renderer emits itself, so any HTML in a transcript shows up as text — same for table cells, code blocks and links, and links only accept `http(s)://`.
- Redaction is on by default and replaces matches with `[REDACTED]`. Turning it off is an explicit choice you have to make.

dsh-transcript-export README · Development：```bash
npm test        # node --test test/core.test.mjs test/host.test.mjs
npm run index   # regenerate market/index.json (pass --repo for the real repository URL)
```

dsh-transcript-export README · Development：- `test/core.test.mjs` covers normalization, redaction, all three renderers, HTML escaping, Markdown structure, nested fences and the helpers.
- `test/host.test.mjs` drives the real route through a miniature Cordis context: export, save, list, read back, delete, unique names on repeat saves, plus traversal, cross-origin and unknown-action refusals.
- `.github/workflows/test.yml` runs the same suite on Node 20 and 22 with nothing to install.

dsh-transcript-export README · Releasing：```bash
git remote add origin https://github.com/ruiyuxuanyan/dsh-transcript-export.git
git branch -M main && git push -u origin main
```

To be listed in the default market, add one line to [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) under **Sessions & Messages**, in both `README.md` and `README.zh.md`, matching the neighbouring entries:

dsh-transcript-export README · Releasing：```markdown
- [ruiyuxuanyan/dsh-transcript-export](https://github.com/ruiyuxuanyan/dsh-transcript-export) - Export any conversation as clean Markdown, one self-contained HTML file, or JSON from the assistant action row, with turn ranges, Markdown-rendered prose, one folded command appendix per round, secret redaction and a searchable export library.
```

dsh-transcript-export README · Releasing：That list is compiled into a format 1 index (`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-plugin-catalog/index.json`) which `dsh-market` and the built-in Discover tab both read — so merging the PR is publishing.

dsh-transcript-export README · What it cannot do yet：- It exports the **text layer**: images you uploaded are listed by path rather than embedded (inlining base64 would turn a one-page HTML into megabytes).
- A whole-conversation export is not small — hundreds of KB of Markdown is normal. Pick "last N rounds" when the point is sharing.
- If the Host has never loaded the session, it falls back to the on-disk log. When neither is readable the export fails loudly instead of writing half a document.
